genesis.title: The Genesis
genesis.text: In 2017, at the beginning of digital transformation, I proposed to my employer to set up a digital incubator to quickly experiment with all the latest digital technologies. The request was obviously denied due to lack of budget, space, and resources. So I decided to do it on my own, alongside my work, using my own resources. This is how I created a personal digital incubator, with the goal of testing and experimenting with innovative ideas using cutting-edge technologies.

objective.title: The Objective
objective.text: The main objective of this incubator is to allow me to explore emerging technologies and develop my innovation management skills. This initiative has enabled me to carry out several innovative projects, experiment with new approaches, and stay at the forefront of technological advances. It is also a creative space where I can bring my ideas to life without the constraints of the traditional professional environment.

current.title: The Incubator in 2025
current.text: As of early 2025, the incubator is more active than ever, given my limited means and the few hours I can invest in it. Here are the main equipment and technologies I currently use. Generally, I always try to use free or open source software when possible.

equipment.title: Equipment Used in 2025

equipment.electronics: Electronics project equipment (soldering iron, power supply, anti-static mat, electronic component kits)

future.title: What's Next
future.text: The arrival of ChatGPT and large language models has transformed my personal digital incubator by enabling me to learn and develop innovative applications much faster. Since I work alone on my incubator, the automation of several tasks thanks to AI allows me to maximize the little time I can dedicate to it. I am currently developing several innovative projects using AI, particularly in the areas of content creation, application development (like this website), task automation, and data analysis.
future.project1: Creation of an application environment for a suite of apps based on the latest web technologies
future.project2: Fine-tuning an open-source large language model based on my knowledge
future.project3: Development of a technology watch application to replace Flipboard
future.project5: Creation of a sovereign personal cloud
future.conclusion: The personal digital incubator is a constantly evolving project. I continue to explore new technologies and develop new projects. My goal is to continue learning and innovating, while sharing my knowledge and experiences with other technology enthusiasts. If you are interested in innovation and digital technologies, feel free to contact me. I would be delighted to discuss my projects and share my ideas with you.
